row.reason: Both sell to employers in the HR and benefits space. Paylocity sells a unified HCM and payroll software platform. HealthEquity is mainly an HSA custodian and consumer-directed benefits administrator (FSA, HRA, COBRA, commuter). The customers overlap, but the core products differ. HealthEquity has no payroll or HR software, and Paylocity has no HSA custody. So the two are adjacent, not direct competitors.
